messages.subject: Opening .sav files using Lavaan's package
parts: Hello. Can anyone provide instructions on how to open a file from SPSS via R (not R studio)? This information and videos I see are dated and not helpful.

messages.author: bc810b1d0900407f
messages.subject: Re: Opening .sav files using Lavaan's package
parts:
Not really about lavaan but I did something like this a lot when introducing lavaan to AMOS/SPSS users ....

You may try this set of functions:

https://haven.tidyverse.org/reference/read_spss.html

If categorical variables are stored as numeric variables with value labels in the SPSS file, check this:

https://haven.tidyverse.org/reference/labelled_spss.html

Hope this helps.

-- Shu Fai
